arms.name: Single Agent Baseline
arms.description: One coding agent completes the task alone without contract orchestration.

arms.name: Uncoordinated Dual-Agent Baseline
arms.description: Two agents in ordinary isolated worktrees with the same written prompt, standard CI gate, and human reviewer pass.

arms.name: Synapse-Mux Heterogeneous (Claude + Codex)
arms.description: Contract-first orchestration, hash-locked contract tests, partition enforcement, and deterministic verification.

arms.name: Synapse-Mux Homogeneous Ablation
arms.description: Identical Synapse-Mux workflow using two workers from the same provider to test cross-model contribution.

arms.name: Sequential Single Agent with Contract
arms.description: One agent given the approved contract and contract tests working sequentially.

primary_threshold.condition: >= 25% lower median human integration time than Baseline B with no reduction in hidden-test pass rate
primary_threshold.secondary_gate: hidden-test pass rate not below Arm D at comparable or lower wall-clock time
